name: Streaming Legal Regulation Of Digital Financial Assets In Russia 3B3F988B87
text: Legal regulation of digital financial assets in Russia recommends adding a legal definition of cryptocurrency system and a classification of digital currency to Federal Law 259-FZ. This independently identifies the definition-and-classification design problem to which Kaal's broad digital-asset definition responds. The abstract does not endorse Kaal's definition or specify the categories the Russian law should adopt.
